parts.name: Seat control box
parts.tip: A rectangular box with its aft inboard corner cut at 45 deg for the seat panel. Angles are worked out from reference views: aft wall 65 deg from the deck, seat face 63 deg from the deck and turned 48 deg toward the right side, top tilted 28 deg to the deck. Width, depth and height are estimated. The back and the outboard end don't show in any reference I have, so those are my own shapes: back square to the deck, outboard end leaning 20 deg inboard.

parts.name: Seat Adjust panel
parts.tip: Seat Adjust panel, 65 mm wide, set into the seat face with the same 4.4 mm margin on all four sides. Its bottom edge follows the slanted bottom edge of the face, so it is taller at the outboard edge than at the inboard edge. Toggle, legends and screws keep The Warthog Project's spacing.

parts.name: EMER BRAKE handle
parts.tip: One L-shaped part, square to the plate side to side. Grip 59 deg from the foot (measured), 8 thick, 14.5 wide tapering to 10.5, heel radius about 6, foot 13 tall and about 47 from heel to block. The shaft runs 8 deg to the deck (my choice; the jet's is 25), which stands the grip 51 deg above the deck.
